newsitem.title: USA: IVAX says president Strauss resigns.
newsitem.headline: IVAX says president Strauss resigns.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Friday that President and Chief Operating Officer Robert Strauss has resigned.
In a statement released by the company, Strauss said his decision to leave was personal.
Strauss said that he and chairman and Chief Executive Phillip Frost "have a high regard for each other, and my leaving is quite amicable."
"It is simply a matter of differing management styles and vision for the company," he added.
Frost said in a statement that he anticipates announcing the appointment of a new president and chief operating officer "very shortly."
